why: diagnostix-analytics calls RVP POST /diagnose for every peer assessment and reads the response. 8.11.52 removed healthCheckScore from it, Analytics rejected every peer, and the delivered report said 'against 0 comparable businesses'. No test on either side pinned the response. This file is that pin. An IDENTICAL copy lives in diagnostix-analytics/test/fixtures/, and each repo tests its own side against it: RVP that the real response satisfies it, Analytics that its real acceptance check accepts the example and rejects the example without the score. A change to what either side needs must change this file in BOTH repos.
consumers: diagnostix-analytics lib/orchestrator.js assessOnce: rejects the response unless typeof healthCheckScore === 'number'
diagnostix-analytics lib/orchestrator.js: healthCheckScore read into the run's score range
diagnostix-analytics lib/orchestrator.js: benchmarkId verified and stored on bulk_run_subjects

required.healthCheckScore: integer 0 to 100, the overall under rvp-overall-mean-v2: the mean of the six pillar scores rounded half up, except that Employee Sentiment at exactly 50 (the no-public-signal value) is left out and the other five are averaged; null only when the six are not all present, and Analytics then refuses the peer
required.pillars: object carrying every key in pillarKeys, each with an integer score 0 to 100
required.benchmarkId: string, or null when the benchmark write was skipped; the key must be present

optional.provenance: object, from 2026-09-30 (RVP B5, lib-provenance.js buildProvenance): methodVersion, passes (label, model, promptVersion, tokens), promptVersions, confidence, durationMs, writtenAt. Additive: Analytics does not read it, and a response without it is still valid.
